name: Market Intelligence
purpose: Build the evidence base for what to build and for whom, before engineering time is committed.

name: Product Definition
purpose: Turn the opportunity into a specification that can be designed, costed and tested against.

name: Design Engineering
purpose: Produce the electrical, mechanical and thermal design that meets the specification.

name: Quality & Reliability
purpose: Prove the design before it is committed to volume, and define how every unit will be tested.

name: Sourcing & Manufacturing
purpose: Secure parts and build capacity with known lead times, alternates and process controls.

name: Commercial & Fulfilment
purpose: Keep proposals, orders and deliveries aligned with what engineering and manufacturing can deliver.

name: Finance & Costing
purpose: Keep a live cost model so design and sourcing choices are made with their cost impact visible.

name: Telemetry & Lifecycle
purpose: Feed test and field data back into the design, and manage change and obsolescence over the product's life.
